gate_plan.gates: DEV75 + DEV250 at half and at the end of each step (RFT 218/435, DPO 571/1,142), batch-32 dynamic-cache greedy, bf16, the settings gate 536 used
gate_plan.rule: R1-offline: the R1 later-gate table at every gate; reference = the starting model's gate result at the first gate, the previous gate after that (R1's first-gate 'edit beats the parent' floor is not used: the start model is already gated)
gate_plan.extra_rows: noedit_dodge (stop-for-user if [NO_EDIT] on edit cases rises by >= 3 while exact edits do not rise); dpo_chosen_collapse (DPO; stop-for-user if the 50-update chosen log-ratio means fall three times in a row to below 0 while score250 <= the start's)
gate_plan.adoption: R5 at the step's result (final gate, or the last good gate after a rollback): adopt if score250 >= start + 5, nofp <= start + 1, valid >= start - 1; 1-4 is stop-for-user; else discard. For RFT from arm A 536: adopt needs score250 >= 122, nofp <= 9, valid >= 73
gate_plan.pre_update_gates: RFT: the SFT masking gate; DPO: pair-batch gate and reference alignment (step-0 policy within mean 0.5 / max 2.0 nats of the stored reference)
gate_plan.overrides: override-step-<step>.json in the evidence directory, as in C04
